refinements.name: 永夜辗眠
refinements.description: 装备者暴击率提升24%；造成的伤害无视目标15%风属性伤害抗性；装备者发动[强化特殊技]造成风属性伤害时，造成的失衡值提升16%，全队其他角色造成的伤害提升20%，持续50秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，伤害提升效果全队唯一。
refinements.descriptionEn: The equipper's CRIT Rate increases by 24%. DMG dealt ignores 15% of the target's Wind RES. When the equipper uses an EX Special Attack to deal Wind DMG, Daze dealt increases by 16%, and DMG dealt by all other squad members increases by 20%, for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Only one instance of the DMG increase effect can exist in the same squad.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：小心风寒
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按或长按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方滑行，造成风属性伤害；
滑行期间若保持长按 【强化特殊技键】 ，洛克茜进入[自旋]状态：
[自旋]状态下洛克茜会化作一阵龙卷风，期间拖曳摇杆可以控制龙卷风的移动方向，期间持续消耗能量并对路径上的敌人造成风属性伤害。能量耗尽或松开 【强化特殊技键】 且不拖曳摇杆时，退出[自旋]状态；
结束滑行或退出[自旋]状态时，自动衔接[强化特殊技：敬请安息]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Slides forward, dealing Wind DMG.
While sliding, press and hold [EX Special Attack] to have Roxy enter the Whirlwind state:
While in the Whirlwind state, Roxy generates a tornado. Drag the joystick to control its direction. During this, Energy is continuously consumed, dealing Wind DMG to enemies along its path. When Energy is depleted, or when [EX Special Attack] is released while the joystick is not being moved, Roxy exits the Whirlwind state.
When the slide ends or when exiting the Whirlwind state, automatically follows up with EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text:
每消耗25点能量，获得1点[风能]，[风能]上限为3点；
洛克茜的初始能量自动回复大于1.2时，超过部分每超过0.01，攻击力提升5点，最多提升960点，冲击力提升0.4点，最多提升76.8点；
[特殊技：恕不远送]命中处于[风化]状态中的敌人后，会触发[净化]，[浸染]状态被还原；
队伍中任意队友触发[浸染]或[净化]效果时，洛克茜将根据[浸染]或[净化]的属性为全队角色提供增益效果：洛克茜每拥有1%暴击率，非[锋御]角色造成对应属性以及风属性伤害时，暴击伤害提升0.4%，最多提升40%；[锋御]角色造成对应属性以及风属性伤害时，锐暴伤害提升0.2%，最多提升20%；每个属性增益效果分别持续50秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
对已经处于[风化]状态下的敌人再次施加[风化]时，根据被覆盖的[风化]状态下的[浸染]属性及风属性，全队角色同样可以获得该增益效果。
facts.textEn:
Gain 1 point of Wind Energy for every 25 Energy consumed, up to a maximum of 3 Wind Energy.
When Roxy's initial Energy Regen exceeds 1.2, for every 0.01 above this value, ATK increases by 5, up to a maximum increase of 960, and Impact increases by 0.4, up to a maximum increase of 76.8.
After Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off hits an enemy affected by Windswept, it triggers Cleanse, reverting Contamination back to its original state.
When any squad member triggers Contamination or Cleanse, Roxy provides all squad members with a buff based on the attribute of the Contamination or Cleanse effect: for every 1% CRIT Rate Roxy has, when non-Armorer characters deal DMG of the corresponding attribute or Wind DMG, their CRIT DMG increases by 0.4%, up to 40%. When Armorer characters deal DMG of the corresponding attribute or Wind DMG, their Laceration DMG increases by 0.2%, up to 20%. Each attribute's buff lasts 50s, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
When Windswept is applied again to an enemy already in the Windswept state, all squad members can also gain this buff based on the Contamination attribute of the overwritten Windswept state and Wind attribute.

cinema.name: 全能执事
cinema.description: [强化特殊技：敬请安息]命中时，使敌方全属性伤害抗性降低15%，持续50秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；自身暴击伤害提升40%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace hits, it reduces the enemy's All-Attribute RES by 15% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. CRIT DMG increases by 40%.

cinema.name: 下班神话
cinema.description: [强化特殊技：小心风寒]造成的失衡值提升5%；每引爆1个[风眼]，获得一层[流势]效果，至多获得3层；在[强化特殊技：小心风寒]期间进入[自旋]状态下换人时，洛克茜将消耗所有[流势]，每消耗1层可以维持[自旋]状态0.2秒，期间不消耗能量，至多维持0.6秒；[强化特殊技：小心风寒]命中敌人时，使敌人失衡易伤倍率提升30%，持续到目标从失衡状态恢复。
cinema.descriptionEn:
EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill deals 5% more Daze.
For each Eye of the Storm detonated, gain 1 stack of Windflow, up to 3 stacks.
During EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill, if Roxy switches out after entering the Whirlwind state, she consumes all Windflow. Each stack consumed sustains the Whirlwind state for 0.2s, during which no Energy is consumed, up to a maximum of 0.6s.
When EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill hits an enemy, that enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% until the target recovers from Stun.

cinema.name: 失眠奇谭
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: R.I.P.
cinema.description: 发动[招架支援]成功招架敌人攻击时，洛克茜回复1点能量，招式内至多回复1次；[闪避反击：礼尚往来]命中敌人时，回复2点能量，招式内至多回复1次；[终结技：葬夜安魂曲]造成的伤害提升20%，失衡值提升10%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When a Defensive Assist successfully parries an enemy attack, Roxy gains 1 Energy, up to once per skill. When Dodge Counter: Returned Courtesy hits an enemy, it grants 2 Energy, up to once per skill. Ultimate: Requiem for the Night-Burial deals 20% more DMG and 10% more Daze.

cinema.name: 第二次心跳
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 永远与自动发条人偶
cinema.description: 自身攻击造成的伤害无视目标15%风属性伤害抗性；[特殊技：恕不远送]引爆[风眼]生成巨型风旋时，主目标会被赋予[余响]效果，每间隔3秒在目标位置生成一次巨型风旋，共额外生成2次巨型风旋，重复触发时额外生成次数叠加且刷新[余响]的持续时间；巨型风旋造成的伤害倍率提升至原本的250%，造成的失衡提升20%。
cinema.descriptionEn: The DMG dealt by attacks ignores 15% of the target's Wind RES. When Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off detonates Eyes of the Storm to generate a Giant Windstorm, the primary target is inflicted with Afterecho. A Giant Windstorm is generated at the target's location every 3s, for a total of 2 additional Giant Windstorms. Repeated triggers stack the number of additional Giant Windstorm instances generated and refresh the duration of Afterecho. The DMG multiplier of the Giant Windstorm increases to 250% of its original value, and the Daze it inflicts increases by 20%.

[自旋]状态下洛克茜会化作一阵龙卷风，期间拖曳摇杆可以控制龙卷风的移动方向，期间持续消耗能量并对路径上的敌人造成风属性伤害。能量耗尽或松开 【强化特殊技键】 且不拖曳摇杆时，退出[自旋]状态；
结束滑行或退出[自旋]状态时，自动衔接[强化特殊技：敬请安息]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough energy, press or hold [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Slides forward, dealing Wind DMG.
While sliding, press and hold [EX Special Attack] to have Roxy enter the Whirlwind state:
While in the Whirlwind state, Roxy generates a tornado. Drag the joystick to control its direction. During this, Energy is continuously consumed, dealing Wind DMG to enemies along its path. When Energy is depleted, or when [EX Special Attack] is released while the joystick is not being moved, Roxy exits the Whirlwind state.
When the slide ends or when exiting the Whirlwind state, automatically follows up with EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：敬请安息
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace
ex.description:
[强化特殊技：小心风寒]结束自动发动：
消耗全部[风能]向前方发射风炮，造成风属性伤害；
每消耗1点[风能]，在攻击后额外造成一次风属性伤害，并在原地生成1个[风眼]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
Automatically activates after EX Special Attack: Don't Catch a Chill ends:
Consumes all Wind Energy to fire a wind cannon forward, dealing Wind DMG.
After the attack, for each point of Wind Energy consumed, deals an additional instance of Wind DMG and generates 1 Eye of the Storm at the current position.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 风眼
ex.description:
[强化特殊技：敬请安息]消耗[风能]后生成，持续30秒后自动引爆；
[风眼]最多同时存在9个，超出上限后最早生成的[风眼]会自动引爆；
被[特殊技：恕不远送]命中时将其引爆，若同时命中数量不足3个，每个[风眼]位置上都会生成1阵微型风旋，追踪敌人并造成风属性伤害，持续1秒；
若同时命中3个，则会生成1阵巨型风旋作为替代，造成风属性伤害，持续1秒。
通过任意方式引爆时，[风眼]会发出爆鸣对周围敌人造成一次风属性伤害。
ex.descriptionEn:
Generated after EX Special Attack: Kindly Rest in Peace consumes Wind Energy, and automatically detonates after 30s.
Up to 9 Eyes of the Storm can exist at the same time. If this limit is exceeded, the earliest generated Eye of the Storm will automatically detonate.
Detonates when hit by Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off. If fewer than 3 are hit at the same time, 1 Miniature Windstorm is generated at the location of each Eye of the Storm, tracking enemies and dealing Wind DMG for 1s.
If 3 are hit at the same time, 1 Giant Windstorm is generated instead, dealing Wind DMG for 1s.
When detonated by any means, an Eye of the Storm releases a blast, dealing 1 instance of Wind DMG to nearby enemies.

ultimate.name: 终结技：葬夜安魂曲
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动强力打击，造成大量风属性伤害；
招式发动后，获得1点[风能]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a large area, dealing massive Wind DMG.
After the skill ends, gains 1 Wind Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：听凭差遣
quickAssist.description:
前场角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向前方进行打击，造成风属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Wind DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

162100014.name: 招架支援：为您分忧
162100014.nameEn: Defensive Assist: Allow Me to Assist
162100014.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
162100014.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
